# Witch City Experiences

> Witch City Experiences is a Salem, Massachusetts company offering immersive ways to experience the history and craft of the Witch City. It is the parent company of three local experiences.

## Brands
- [Witch City Walking Tours](https://witchcitywalkingtours.com/): Guided historic walking tours through the streets of Salem, Massachusetts.
- [Witch City Broom Making Workshop](https://witchcitybroomco.com/pages/broom-making-workshop): Hands-on broom-making workshops at 32 Derby Square, Salem, MA 01970 — design and decorate your own custom souvenir broom with local instructors.
- [Witch City Broom Co.](https://witchcitybroomco.com/): A brick-and-mortar retail shop at 246 Essex St, Salem, MA 01970, offering handcrafted brooms and take-home craft kits.

## Location
Salem, Massachusetts, United States. Broom Making Workshop: 32 Derby Square, Salem, MA 01970. Witch City Broom Co. retail shop: 246 Essex St, Salem, MA 01970.
